rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the shared travel arrangement, not for the people in it.

example.english: Our company set up a carpool and saved quite a bit on fuel.
example.traditional: 我哋公司搞咗個夾車，慳返唔少油錢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gaau2 zo2 go3 gaap3 ce1 haan1 faan1 m4 siu2 jau4 cin2

rows.note: Use this when you mean the participating people as a group rather than the carpool arrangement itself.

example.english: Everyone in the carpool agreed to meet at the MTR station today.
example.traditional: 夾車嘅人今日約咗喺地鐵站集合。
example.jyutping: gaap3 ce1 ge3 jan4 gam1 jat6 joek3 zo2 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 zaap6 hap6
